base_member_text: Cross-line: READ_VALUE opens unit 10 (L283) but the success path RETURNs at L299 without CLOSE - only the EOF/failure path closes (L306). Each successful keyword lookup leaves unit 10 open; repeated OPEN on the same unit relies on Fortran reopen semantics.
audit_member_text: READ_VALUE returns on a successful match at line 299 without closing unit 10; CLOSE(10) exists only on the EOF path at line 306. Repeated reads therefore reopen an already-connected hard-coded unit (lines 282-306).

base_member_text: Cross-line: on keyword-not-found (ERR_IF_ONE==1) the readers RETURN with the INTENT(OUT) argument never assigned (L102, L153, L202, L247); callers rely on assigning defaults after the call, but with INTENT(OUT) the variable is formally undefined during the call.

CHECK_CONSISTENCY_TYPE classification edge cases: an all-digit string value (e.g. a numeric filename) classifies as INTEGER so READ_STRING STOPs (L252-261); exponent form without a dot (1E5) classifies as INTEGER so READ_FLOAT STOPs (L157-166); a single 'T'/'F' intended as a string classifies as logical. Whether input.txt conventions avoid these is external.
ERR_IF_ONE lacks an INTENT declaration in READ_INTEGER/READ_FLOAT/READ_LOGICAL (L81, L132, L181) but is INTENT(OUT) in READ_STRING (L225) - inconsistent interface across the generic set.
READ_VALUE lines whose '=' is absent give FRONT=0 and TMPV_NEXT=TEXT(1:-1) empty (L295-296); an empty MatchCharacter would match such lines - callers never pass empty keys, but the guard is absent.
Under PARALLEL, only rank 0 prints diagnostics but ALL ranks call MPI_FINALIZE and STOP on missing file (L86-88); non-collective STOP after MPI_FINALIZE ordering is implementation-dependent.
The license banner says 'FILE main.F' (L3) although this file is mod_input.F.

audit_member_text: The type checker recognizes a float only if a dot exists at lines 340-345. Valid exponent notation without a dot, such as 1E-3, passes the numeric alphabet test at lines 319,332-337 but is classified INTEGER, conflicting with READ_FLOAT (lines 155-165).
The first ! is stripped without quote handling and the first = is always the separator at lines 290-298, so string values containing those characters cannot round-trip.

READ_LOGICAL warns for values other than single-letter T/F at lines 204-211 but then accepts every value beginning with uppercase T at lines 213-214; lowercase true becomes false while unrelated T-prefixed text becomes true.
VAL_READ and VAL_TYPE are shared module variables at lines 61-62, making the public readers non-reentrant under concurrent calls.
